_comment: Rungs are LiteLLM model names, not native Claude Code aliases (except sonnet/opus, which are both). Run via `claude -p --model <rung>` with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN pointed at `litellm --config litellm.config.yaml` (KNOWN_GOOD_VERSIONS.md). Local pilot: exhaust local capability before any tier that costs money.
